firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently rode in a truck has the initial turn-order priority.
houseFallback: If the group cannot distinguish who rode in a truck most recently, agree to choose the initial top Forklift randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Both Forklifts begin on space 0 of the Construction Track. Put the most recent truck rider’s Forklift on top.

Each phase uses the player farther along that track first; a stacked tie goes to the Forklift on top. Construction can be played simultaneously, but either player may request sequential turns. Resolve track movements as though turns were sequential.
Construction can change the track order before Trucking. The initial priority therefore does not guarantee the first Trucking turn.

internalEvidence: Complete publisher-linked PDF retrieved; relevant setup, opening-turn, variant and edition pages read and visually inspected. Reviewed PDF pages: 2, 4, 5, 6, 12. Rendered page 2 puts the latest truck rider on top of the initial stack; it says ridden, not driven. Page 4 defines phase priority and allows simultaneous Construction while preserving sequential resolution of track movement. Pages 5 and 6 show how Construction movement can alter the leader before Trucking. Page 12's Night Shift variant changes components, not the initial criterion. No printing year is inferred.
